content.text: Meric MO.gov Governor Kehoe Find an Agency Online Services Email us(link sends email) View photos on Flickr(link is external) Watch videos on YouTube(link is external) Follow us on Twitter(link is external) Like us on Facebook(link is external) Main navigation Regional Profile Navigation About the Region The Ozark Region is comprised of seven counties, including Greene County, which is home to Springfield, the region’s largest city. In 2023, per capita personal income of the region was $48,882 and estimated population was 580,486. The average annual wage for all occupations in the Ozark Region in 2024 was $52,771. Ozark Region
